## Feature Description

Clearly describe the feature or improvement you'd like to see added to PPGUI.

## Why Is This Feature Useful?

Explain what problem this feature would solve or how it would improve the mod.

## Suggested Implementation

Describe how you imagine the feature working.

For example:
- A new button or control
- Additional player profile information
- Improvements to the 3D player viewer
- New customization options

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any other ways to achieve the same result? If so, describe them here.

## Additional Context

Add any screenshots, mockups, examples, or other information that could help explain your suggestion.
